name: Propylene glycol 40%

sources.title: Engineering ToolBox: propylene glycol based heat-transfer fluids

summary: Water with 40% propylene glycol for outdoor loops in cold climates (freeze point about -22 °C). Carries about 10% less heat per kilogram than PG25 and is twice as viscous, so it needs more pump power.

densityKgM3.note: 1030 kg/m³ at 20 °C, 1016 at 40 °C; specific gravity 1.034 at 60 °F.

viscosityPaS.note: About 4.5 mPa·s at 20 °C for 40% PG (ASHRAE Fundamentals glycol tables); roughly 3 mPa·s at 35 °C.
